title: QBIND Public DevNet Seed / Bootnode List
description: Canonical operator-facing schema for the QBIND public DevNet seed/bootnode list (Run 357). DevNet only: experimental, resettable, no value, no MainNet readiness claim, no C4/C5 closure claim. A seed list document that validates against this schema is NOT a public DevNet launch claim. Entries with status 'placeholder' or 'planned' are NOT live seeds and are NOT externally reachable.

schema_version.description: Version of this seed-list schema/document format.

network_name.description: Human-readable network name, e.g. 'QBIND Public DevNet (experimental)'.

environment.description: Deployment environment. DevNet only for this document.

genesis_hash.description: Canonical Run 101 genesis hash of the Run 356 genesis package (0x-prefixed hex).

genesis_file_sha256.description: File-byte SHA-256 of the Run 356 devnet-genesis.json (lowercase hex, no 0x).

safety_label.description: Mandatory safety label. All flags must be present and set as shown for a DevNet seed list.

placeholder_statement.description: Explicit statement that placeholder/planned entries are not live seeds and are not externally reachable.

seed_nodes.description: List of seed/bootnode entries. May be empty. Placeholder entries must use status 'placeholder' and non-routable / documentation-example values only.

node_id.description: Node identity. Use null to document a deliberate absence.

peer_id.description: P2P peer identity. Use null to document a deliberate absence.

validator_address.description: Validator address if this seed is also a validator; null if not applicable.

p2p_host.description: P2P host. For placeholder/planned entries this MUST be a non-routable / documentation-example value (e.g. an RFC 5737 TEST-NET address or example.invalid).

p2p_multiaddr.description: Connection string usable with the pre-existing --p2p-peer flag (host:port, or vid@host:port). Use null if not applicable.

trust_bundle_required.description: Whether a signed PQC trust bundle is required to join this seed (see --p2p-trust-bundle).

expected_genesis_hash.description: Genesis hash the seed expects peers to pin; must match the top-level genesis_hash for a consistent DevNet.

operator.description: Operator label. For placeholder entries use a non-identifying example value.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the seed entry.

last_reachability_evidence.description: Reference to reachability evidence (e.g. path to an evidence doc or a timestamped probe result). MUST be null for non-live entries; MUST be non-null for status 'live'.

allOf.description: A 'live' seed must carry reachability evidence.
A non-live seed (placeholder/planned/retired) must NOT falsely carry reachability evidence.
